'Check Classes' button uses white bold text on red. Mixed color coding: red for C₁/Class I/positive, blue for C₂/Class II/negative, green for 'Zero'.

recreation_brief: 1) Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0). 2) Top-left: draw a 2×6 matrix with header x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ x₆; row 1 = (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), row 2 = (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6); beneath each column place class labels C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂ C₂ in red/blue. 3) Top-center: write 'Initial W =' above a column vector with 4 over -2; write 'Step η = 2' in red bold; add legend 'C₁ positive C₂ negative Zero is unaccepted' with colored keywords. 4) Top-right: write 'Check classes of' above a matrix with headers Z₁ Z₁ Z₁ and rows (0)(7)(3) / (0)(6)(2); place a yellow circle with '47' at the far top-right. 5) Middle-left: write 'Ugmented Vectors (from Top)' above a 4×6 matrix with header x₁–x₆; rows = all 1s, then (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), then (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6), then (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6); add column labels C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂ C₂. 6) Middle-right: draw three bordered boxes stacked vertically. Box 1: d(Z₁) = [1 0 0; -4 0; 14] = 14 ⇒ Positive > 0, Class I in red. Box 2: d(Z₁) = [1 7 6; -4 0; 14] = -14 ⇒ Negative < 0, Class II in blue. Box 3: d(Z₁) = [1 3 2; -4 0; -2] = -2 ⇒ Negative < 0, Class II in blue. 7) Bottom-left: add a red filled rectangle with white bold text 'Check Classes'.
